title: claude-kit hooks manifest
description: Shape of plugins/<name>/hooks/hooks.json. scripts/validate.mjs is the enforcing copy; this schema is close to it but not identical, and exists for editor completion only.

items.description: additionalProperties is false here, unlike plugin.schema.json's true: this repo authors hooks.json itself, so an unknown key is a typo, whereas a plugin manifest's format is owned by Claude Code and may legitimately gain keys this repo has not seen.

command.description: Must start with `node` and reference a .mjs under ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}.
